info.title: Taytay LGU IDS API
info.summary: Backend for the official app of the LGU of Taytay, Rizal.

get.description: The OpenAPI document itself, not the API envelope.
Reports that the process is up. It does not check PostgreSQL, Firebase, or object storage.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation id echoed on every response.

get.description: Creates the user on first sight. The role is stored on the row after that. verification_status is the tier. rejection_reason is set only while that tier is rejected. closed is true after POST /api/v1/me/close. email_verified is true only after POST /api/v1/auth/email-otp/verify for the current email.

patch.description: Null clears an optional field. Role and verification status cannot be patched. A different email clears email_verified. An email already used by another open account is 409. street and purok are optional structured lines and do not replace address.

409.description: That email is already in use.

200.description: Consent history, newest first, capped at 100.
Admin user list. Address and birthdate are omitted.

patch.description: Cannot target the caller. verified and registered also update verification_status.

post.description: Registered residents only. One pending request per user. JPEG, PNG, or WebP, 5 MB each.

409.description: A request is already pending, or the account is already verified.

get.summary: Latest verification request for the caller

post.description: Sets the resident to verified. A registered role becomes verified. Staff and admin roles are left unchanged.
Notes are required. The account stays registered and may submit again.

delete.description: Refused while staff or later records still reference the office.

patch.summary: Link a staff account to an office
patch.description: office_id null clears the link. A non-staff account cannot be assigned an office.

422.description: Target is not staff, or the office does not exist.

post.description: Staff may post only for their own office. Admins choose the office. Drafts are hidden from the public list.

get.description: Published articles are public. Drafts are visible to the office's staff and to admins.

404.description: Not found, or a draft the caller cannot see.

patch.description: Staff can edit only articles of their own office. Publishing sets published_at the first time.

get.description: Information only. There is no application endpoint.

post.summary: Attach an image to a service

get.description: A verified resident sees their threads. Staff see their office inbox. Admins see every thread. Each row includes subject, last_message_preview (first 140 characters), last_message_at, and unread_count.

post.summary: Start or continue a thread with an office
post.description: Verified residents only. subject is stored when the thread is created. An open thread for the same resident and office is reused and keeps its original subject. A closed thread starts a new one.

200.description: Message added to the open thread.

post.summary: Mark a thread read for the caller

post.description: Staff of that office, or an admin. The resident can start a new thread afterwards.

post.summary: Upload an image and return metadata
post.description: Bytes go through MediaStore. The response does not include the storage key.

get.description: The owner, staff, and admins can read metadata. Another resident receives 404.
Active banners, quick links, active hotlines, the latest published Balita, and featured Tulong services.
Admin only. Rows store actor, action code, and subject id. They do not store addresses, notes, or message text.
Public. Inactive rows are omitted. Ordered by sort_order, then name. Capped at 100.
LGU contact line, support email, current privacy and terms versions, minimum app version, and public feature flags. Flags are not secrets.

patch.description: Admin only. Null clears a field. A feature flag value of null deletes that key.

post.description: Stores the device for the signed-in user. The same token moved to another account is reassigned. The token is not returned. Delivery uses the mock push provider.

delete.description: Deletes the token only when it belongs to the caller. Another account's token is 404.

get.description: One row per notification type. A missing row means in-app and push are both on.

post.description: Soft-deletes the account, clears profile fields, device tokens, and verification image bytes, and writes an audit row. A later call is 409. GET /api/v1/me still works and returns closed: true.

Registered role only. Sends a 6-digit code to the profile email. The code is stored only as a hash, expires after 10 minutes, locks after 5 wrong attempts, and a resend inside 60 seconds does not send another message. Limits per 15 minutes: 5 per email and 15 per IP.

202.description: Accepted. The same body is returned during the resend cooldown.

409.description: The email is already verified, or the account is closed.

503.description: The email could not be sent.

post.description: Registered role only. On success, marks the email verified through IdentityAdmin and on the profile. A wrong, expired, locked, or used code is 422.

503.description: The email could not be verified.

post.description: Public. Always returns 202 for a well-formed email, whether or not an account exists, including during the 60 second cooldown and when the mailer fails. The response does not say which.

post.summary: Exchange a reset code for a reset token
post.description: Public. Returns a single-use reset token that expires after 15 minutes. A wrong, expired, locked, used, or unknown code is the same 422.

Public. Sets the password through IdentityAdmin. Writes audit password.reset_completed with the user id only. An unknown, used, or expired token is 422. A weak password does not spend the token. If the identity call fails the token is released.

422.description: The token or the password is not valid.

503.description: The password could not be updated.

get.summary: Get the signed-in resident's digital ID
get.description: Verified residents only. Issued automatically when an ID review is approved. qr is a short-lived signed payload containing the card id, expiry, and a nonce. It is null when the card is suspended, revoked, or past expires_at. The payload has no name, address, or id number.

post.description: Staff and admin. Checks the signature and the QR expiry. A bad or expired code is 422 and returns no holder. A valid code returns the name, photo, status, whether the card itself is past expires_at, and the barangay. Audit digital_id.scanned.

422.description: That QR code is not valid.

get.summary: Get a resident's current digital ID
get.description: Admin. The current active or suspended card. Revoked-only history is 404.

post.description: Admin. The user must be a verified resident with no current card. photo_media_id must belong to that resident. When omitted, the latest approved verification selfie is used. Audit digital_id.issued.

409.description: Not a verified resident, closed, or a card already exists.

post.description: Admin. Only an active card can be suspended. Audit digital_id.suspended.
Admin. An active or suspended card becomes revoked. Closing the account or removing the verified role does this too. Audit digital_id.revoked.
Admin. Revokes the named card and issues a new one with the same photo, when the resident is still verified. Audit digital_id.reissued.

409.description: The resident cannot hold a new card.

get.description: Staff and admin. barangay_id is required. Rows are id, barangay_id, member_count, and created_at. Names, birthdates, and addresses are omitted.

post.description: Registered or verified resident. The caller becomes the head. The profile must already have a name. A person can belong to one household.

get.description: Accepted members and the head. Pending invitations do not count.

post.summary: Add a household member or invite a user
post.description: Head only. Without user_id the member is unlinked. With user_id the person must accept the invitation. At most 20 members.

404.description: No household, or the invited user was not found.

409.description: That person already belongs to a household, or the household is full.

patch.description: Head only. The head row itself is changed by transferring headship.

409.description: The head cannot be edited this way.

delete.description: Head only. The head cannot be removed.

post.description: An accepted member who is not the head.
Head only. The new head must be an accepted member linked to a user.

409.description: That member cannot become the head.

get.summary: Get the caller's pending household invitation
get.description: Returns the invitation id, household id, address, and barangay. Other members are not included.

post.description: The invited user only. A person already in a household is 409.

firebaseIdToken.description: Firebase is the identity provider and nothing else. The API verifies the ID token and reads the role from that token. The local mock accepts `Bearer mock:<role>:<subjectId>` and does not call Firebase. Firestore is not used.

error.message: The request could not be validated.

name: String must contain at least 1 character(s)

email_verified.description: True when the current email was confirmed with a code.

street.description: Structured street line. The free-text address field is unchanged.

rejection_reason.description: Notes from the latest rejection. Null unless verification_status is rejected.

new_password.description: 8 to 128 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.

id_number.description: Municipal card number. Not a national government identifier.

token.description: Signed payload. Claims are card_id, exp, and nonce.
